ko.title: 후드를 잡고 계속
ko.caption: 후드를 잡고 계속
ko.intro: 코발트 셸을 중심으로 이너와 타이츠를 어둡게 맞춰요. 후드는 시야를 가리지 않게 조절하고 반사 디테일과 별개로 주변 교통을 확인하세요.

en.title: KEEP MOVING THROUGH THE RAIN
en.caption: Keep moving through the rain
en.intro: Let the cobalt shell stand out against dark base layers and tights. Adjust the hood so it leaves your view clear, and stay aware of traffic even with reflective details.

de.title: KEEP MOVING THROUGH THE RAIN
de.caption: Mit Kapuze weiterlaufen
de.intro: Setze die kobaltblaue Jacke mit dunklem Funktionslayer und dunklen Tights in Szene. Stelle die Kapuze so ein, dass die Sicht frei bleibt, und achte trotz Reflexdetails auf den Verkehr.

copy.tipNote: The batch supplies no separate tip; the look-level howToWear (incl. its safety sentence) is the intro.

products.descriptor: bright cobalt blue lightweight hooded running rain jacket with black full front zipper and small vertical black chest zipper, narrow silver reflective strips along outer forearms
products.restorationNote: Final photograph shows chest zip and reflective sleeve stripes.

howToWear.ko: 후드는 한 손으로 이마 위까지 당겨 쓰고, 지퍼를 목 아래까지 올려 상체를 코발트 한 색으로 덮어요.
howToWear.en: Pull the hood forward over your brow with one hand and zip to just below the neck so cobalt covers the whole torso.
howToWear.de: Die Kapuze mit einer Hand bis über die Stirn ziehen und den Reißverschluss bis knapp unter den Hals schließen, sodass Kobaltblau den ganzen Oberkörper bedeckt.
